messages.limits.ai_scope: The AI only picks labels from fixed lists. It writes no text, gives no numbers, and cannot move people or decide who notices an ad.
messages.limits.fictional: All people, places and products are fictional.
messages.limits.names: Names and descriptions of the people are never sent to the AI.
messages.limits.names.persona: The AI reads each fictional person's whole profile, name and life story included, so it can answer as them. The rules use only interests and traits.
messages.limits.not_feelings: The labels are the AI's ratings of an ad for a fictional profile, not anyone's thoughts or feelings.
messages.limits.not_feelings.persona: The labels are the AI's guess at how this fictional person would react, not anyone's real thoughts or feelings.
messages.limits.not_forecast: This is not a forecast and not validated psychology. Purchases are not simulated; the purchase-interest score is an uncalibrated rules-only number.
messages.limits.replay: A new live run can get different AI answers. This saved run always replays the same, without calling the AI.
messages.limits.title: What this is, and what it is not
messages.limits.vendor: AdLife records the model name it asked for; it cannot confirm which model version the service actually ran.
